title: On-Site Care Medical Check-Up
body:
Bringing medical services directly to the workplace makes health examinations more convenient and accessible.

To accommodate companies with a large number of employees, Amalia Medical Center provides On-Site Medical Check-Up (MCU) services. Our medical team comes to your location with complete medical examination equipment, including a mobile X-ray unit and a soundproof booth for audiometry testing.

On-Site Medical Check-Up services can also be arranged for individuals at home or at the office whenever needed.
